responsibility: Defines the core exception-handling data structures and public APIs shared across GCC’s EH lowering, expansion, and emission phases. It declares eh_region, eh_landing_pad, eh_catch, and eh_status representations, region kinds such as cleanup/try/allowed-exceptions/must-not-throw, iteration macros over EH trees, and the routines for creating, querying, duplicating, verifying, lowering, and expanding EH regions, landing pads, builtin EH operations, and function exception tables.
same_name_distinction: Defines the core EH data structures, enums, iteration macros, and cross-phase function declarations that other code uses to manipulate exception regions; unlike gcc/except.cc, it is the shared structural/interface header rather than the implementation of EH processing and verification.
